Problem Statement:
Write a program to check the given two number is betrothed number or not 
Input Description:
The input contains an integer 
Output Description:
If its betrothed print Yes otherwise No 
Sample Input:
48 75 
Sample Output:
Yes 
Explanation:
Betrothed numbers are two positive numbers such that the sum of the proper divisors of either number is one more than (or one plus) the value of the other number.
